info.title: ContactCenterAI dedicated Meta webhook
info.description: Only this surface may be tunneled. Telegram uses outbound long polling. No cookies, login, private product or admin routes.

servers.description: Loopback behind optional public HTTPS tunnel

get.description: Subscription verification only. Constant-time verify-token comparison. Does not authenticate POST.

post.description: HMAC-SHA256 of raw bytes with app secret; body <=256 KiB/depth 32/max100 events. Fixed endpoint/recipient allowlist. Commit accepted or deliberately ignored inputs before acknowledgment.

200.description: Durably accepted, duplicate or deliberately ignored; not an AI answer

503.description: Channel disabled or durable storage unavailable
